name: ai_content_studio
description: A free and open-source tool that automates the creation of YouTube content by writing scripts, generating AI voiceovers, producing videos, and uploading them automatically to enable hands-free channel growth.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.description: The subject or theme on which the script and video content are to be generated.

inputs.name: script parameters
inputs.description: Configuration settings or inputs that guide script writing such as tone, length, or style.

inputs.name: voiceover options
inputs.description: Settings for voice synthesis including voice type, language, and speech speed.

inputs.name: video settings
inputs.description: Parameters to configure video creation such as resolution, background visuals, and templates.

inputs.name: upload credentials
inputs.description: Authentication information required to upload the final video to YouTube automatically.

outputs.name: script
outputs.description: AI-generated text script ready for narration or voiceover.

outputs.name: voiceover audio
outputs.description: AI-generated voiceover audio based on the script.

outputs.name: video file
outputs.description: Compiled video combining the script narration, voiceover, and visuals.

outputs.name: upload status
outputs.description: Result and status of the automated YouTube upload process including success or failure messages.

steps: Receive topic and optional script parameters from the user
Generate a video script using AI content writing techniques
Convert script text into voiceover audio using AI-driven text-to-speech
Produce video by combining voiceover with generated or selected visuals
Upload the finished video to YouTube through automated API calls
Provide status feedback on upload completion and video availability
use_cases: YouTubers seeking to automate video content generation and publishing
Content marketers creating scripted video content quickly without manual effort
Businesses automating voiceover and video creation for promotional materials
Educational content creators generating tutorial videos from textual scripts
Influencers leveraging AI to scale video production and channel growth
patterns: Automated video assembly combining audio and visuals
Integration of content creation with YouTube API for automated publishing

prompt_templates.name: script_generation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Write a detailed and engaging YouTube video script about {topic} with a {tone} tone, lasting about {length} minutes.

prompt_templates.name: voiceover_configuration_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Generate a natural-sounding voiceover in {language} using a {voice_type} voice at {speech_speed} speed for the provided script.

prompt_templates.name: video_creation_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Combine the voiceover audio with relevant visuals and background effects to create a {resolution} resolution video suited for YouTube.

prompt_templates.name: upload_video_prompt
prompt_templates.template: Upload the video titled '{video_title}' to the YouTube channel authenticated by the provided credentials with the description '{video_description}'.
